answer: Picture a nebula of fresh agent identities fanning out from a single operator. Each mask looks independent, yet their funding paths and invite edges weave one shared trellis: the same wallet seeded them, the same referrer vouched. A correlation engine traces those edges and collapses the cluster into one effective actor, capping its combined reward share. To stay separate an attacker must bankroll each identity from ferrous, unlinked sources and earn distinct invite provenance per mask - real capital and real time spent, not one inference pipeline wearing many faces.
